# NXG Media

NXG Media is a growth and AI visibility studio founded by Joost van Putten. NXG Media helps coaches, knowledge experts and local service businesses build online growth systems using storytelling, product ladders, email flows, ads and AI visibility.

> Marketing met Joost is onderdeel van NXG-Media. KVK 78318122.

## Primary services

### Coach Accelerator

The Coach Accelerator helps coaches, specialists and knowledge experts build a complete online growth system: storytelling, mini-products, email flows, Meta Ads and conversion funnels — delivering an average 5-7x return on ad spend.

Primary page:
https://nxg-media.com/coach-accelerator/

Service detail:
https://nxg-media.com/diensten/coach-accelerator/

Relevant cases:
https://nxg-media.com/cases/coach-josine/
https://nxg-media.com/cases/tessa-youlife/
https://nxg-media.com/cases/happy-with-yoga/

### AI Vindbaarheid Audit

The AI Vindbaarheid Audit is a scan and audit approach for local businesses and practices that want to understand how visible and citable they are in AI assistants like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.

Primary page (educational overview):
https://nxg-media.com/ai-vindbaarheid/

90-day AI visibility programme (conversion page with case studies and verified proof):
https://nxg-media.com/ai-vindbaarheid-traject/

Service detail:
https://nxg-media.com/diensten/ai-vindbaarheid-audit/

Scanner:
https://scanner.nxg-media.com

Verified client results:
- Dr. Verena Mann (doc-veri.pages.dev) — from 2 to 19 enquiries per month, 15 consistent ChatGPT mentions
- Costa Blanca Movement Centre (costablancamovement.com) — Google position 4 in 2 weeks, ChatGPT #1 local recommendation (verified with screenshots)

Important note:
AI visibility is a new field. NXG Media does not guarantee rankings or recommendations inside AI tools. The audit identifies technical, content and authority improvements that may improve machine readability, citability and trust signals.
